name: Vaja (Hungary)
description: Two equal horizontal stripes of red over blue, charged at the centre with the town arms of Vaja: a crowned quartered blue and red shield with a crescent, a star, a ploughshare, a castle and a rose, above a yellow scroll inscribed 1836 VAJA 2009.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Vaja arms with crown and scroll
